[type]
Parser

[grammar]
grammar sexpression;

sexpr : item* EOF ;
item : atom
    | list_
    | LPAREN item DOT item RPAREN
    ;

list_ : LPAREN item* RPAREN ;

atom : STRING
    | SYMBOL
    | NUMBER
    | DOT
    ;

STRING : '"' ('\\\\' . | ~ ('\\\\' | '"'))* '"' ;
WHITESPACE : (' ' | '\\n' | '\\t' | '\\r')+ -> skip ;
NUMBER : ('+' | '-')? (DIGIT)+ ('.' (DIGIT)+)? ;
SYMBOL : SYMBOL_START (SYMBOL_START | DIGIT)* ;
LPAREN : '(' ;
RPAREN : ')' ;
DOT : '.' ;

fragment SYMBOL_START
    : ('a' .. 'z')
    | ('A' .. 'Z')
    | '+'
    | '-'
    | '*'
    | '/'
    | '.'
    ;

fragment DIGIT : ('0' .. '9') ;

[start]
sexpr

[input]
()
[output]
[output type=lexer-only-named-types]
[input name=B]
()
[output name=B]
[output name=B type=lexer-only-named-types]
